title: betula alba subsp. nana
intro: Betula alba subsp. nana, commonly known as Dwarf Birch, is a subspecies of the Betula alba species, a type of small deciduous tree or shrub native to northern Europe. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Betula alba subsp. nana include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and betulinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
